**Creating windmill architecture**

I’m working on the windmill architecture without any bones. The windmill will have four rectangular, tapered blades centered around a point. I plan to use BoxGeometry for dimensions and will need to adjust rotation using quaternion and degrees for the XYZ axes. The blades will lie in the X/Y plane, with the geometry centered but positioned radially. I’ll also configure the rotor to be in the XY plane, adjusting for dimensions and offset on the local Y axis.
